final_action.public_message: Passing on Mediterranean—focus stays on the rail lines. Auction it if anyone wants the browns.
final_action.private_thought: Mediterranean is a low-value singleton brown. No synergy with my 3/4 rail monopoly strategy (rent already $100). Cash $1375 is plenty but no need to dilute on unproductive assets. Let auction decide; opponents may overpay or it stays cheap. Consistent with rejecting rail sales.
